# BatchSend (chat block)

• BatchSend(people (static), action? (static))
  - Description: Follow-up messages for several people; the user removes people or edits messages, then sends the batch.
  - people: One entry per person due a follow-up.
    List of maps keys:
    * name - The person's name, e.g. "Priya Sharma".
    * detail - When they were last messaged, e.g. "45 days ago".
    * message - The follow-up drafted for them.
  - action: The verb on the send button. Defaults to "Send".

BatchSend(people, action?) — follow-up messages for several people at once, one row each, that the user can drop or edit before anything is sent; nothing goes out until they tap the send button. Use it for requests like 'follow up with everyone I have not spoken to'. people is a list of {name, detail?, message} where detail is how long ago, e.g. "45 days ago". Events: send_batch {people: [{name, message}]} with only the people still included and their edited text; dismiss_batch {} on Not now. Example: batch = BatchSend([{name: "Priya Sharma", detail: "45 days ago", message: "Hey Priya! It's been a while."}, {name: "Rahul Mehta", detail: "30 days ago", message: "Hi Rahul, how are you?"}])
